<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable>IO:230291253bc37610be82c237f4e45a91</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>getSubjectAttributesFromCSR</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading)
        return;

    if(!(g_user.hasRole('sn_disco_certmgmt.pki_admin') || g_user.hasRole('sn_disco_certmgmt.pki_user') || g_user.hasRole('sn_disco_certmgmt.certificate_requester'))) {
		g_form.addErrorMessage("User is not authorized. User doesn't contain proper roles (pki_admin, pki_user, certificate_requester)");
		return;
	}
	
	var csrAttributeNameList = ["subject_common_name", "subject_alternative_name", "organization", "organizational_unit", "locality", "province", "country", "email"];
    if (newValue == '') {
        setCSRAttributesValue();
        return;
    }

    var ga = new GlideAjax("global.CSRDecodeCertificateAjax");
    ga.addParam("sysparm_name", "getSubjectAttributesFromCSR");
    ga.addParam('sysparm_CSRString', newValue);
    ga.getXML(csrAttributes);


    function csrAttributes(response) {
        var csrAttributes = response.responseXML.documentElement.getAttribute("answer");
        var csrAttrsObj = (csrAttributes) ? JSON.parse(csrAttributes) : '';
        setCSRAttributesValue(csrAttrsObj);
		if (!csrAttrsObj)
			g_form.showFieldMsg('csr', getMessage('Invalid CSR'), 'error');
    }

    function hexToIPv4(hex) {
        var parts = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < 8; i += 2) {
            parts.push(parseInt(hex.substring(i, i + 2), 16));
        }
        return parts.join('.');
    }

    function hexToIPv6(hex) {
        var parts = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < 32; i += 4) {
            var group = hex.substring(i, i + 4).toLowerCase();
            group = group.replace(/^0+/, '');
            parts.push(group === '' ? '0' : group);
        }
        return parts.join(':');
    }

    function setCSRAttributesValue(csrAttrsObj) {
        csrAttributeNameList.forEach(function(csrAttr) {
            if(csrAttr == 'subject_alternative_name' && csrAttrsObj && csrAttrsObj['subject_alternative_name'])
            {
                var newSAN = csrAttrsObj['subject_alternative_name'];
                var regex = /(?:\d+:\s+)?#([a-fA-F0-9\s]{8,})/g;
                newSAN = newSAN.replace(regex, function(match, hexWithSpaces) {
                    var hex = (hexWithSpaces || '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
                    if (hex.length === 8) {
                        return hexToIPv4(hex);
                    } else if (hex.length === 32) {
                        return hexToIPv6(hex);
                    }
                    return match;
                });
                csrAttrsObj['subject_alternative_name'] = newSAN;
            }
            g_form.setValue(csrAttr, (csrAttrsObj && csrAttrsObj[csrAttr]) ? csrAttrsObj[csrAttr] : '');
        });
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-02-13 17:58:59</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>b01255253bc37610be82c237f4e45a84</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>getSubjectAttributesFromCSR</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management" source="sn_disco_certmgmt">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_b01255253bc37610be82c237f4e45a84</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-02-13 17:58:59</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
